pricing_basis: Recompute using the frozen campaign accounting formula: $2/M uncached input, $0.1/M cache read, $2.5/M cache write, $10/M output. This is a usage-based estimate, not invoice payment. Historical ledger differences retained.
important: Scores and cost intervals must be read by experimental condition. The pooled full-success count has no comparable benchmark denominator.
interpretation: The total is an execution ledger, not a comparable benchmark success-rate denominator. One batch43 preparation smoke is separately labelled. native_total counts terminal-score executions only. Interrupted attempts are listed separately and not imputed as zero.
